## What was built

I converted the existing GoldAI XAU Bot dashboard (a passive simulated price ticker) into a complete, playable **trading game** called **"Gold Rush — XAU/USD Trader"** in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/dist/index.html`, served by the existing `server.js` on port 3000.

## Gameplay
- **Session:** 3 minutes per round, starting with $10,000 cash.
- **BUY** — opens a long position with all available cash at the live price (one position at a time).
- **SELL** — closes the position and realizes profit/loss.
- Price ticks every 500ms (random walk with mean reversion, bounded $1850–$2350), drawn on a live canvas chart with an entry-price dashed line when in a position.
- Unrealized PnL, equity, cash, ounces, entry price, and a countdown timer update live.
- **AI signal** (BUY/SELL/HOLD) updates each tick as a hint.
- When time expires, any open position is **auto-sold** and the game-over screen shows final equity, PnL, and a high score persisted in `localStorage`. "Play Again" restarts.

## Screens
Start screen → live game screen → game-over screen, with toasts, a transaction log, and exit/restart controls.

- Single long-only position per session; BUY uses all cash, SELL realizes full proceeds.
